versions.description_html:
Learn why passwords aren't enough and how multi-factor authentication blocks over 99% of attacks. Explore factors, text codes, apps, and passkeys.

Nearly nine in ten attacks on the web start with a stolen password. That's one secret you type into every site you use, so one leak spreads everywhere.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Why a password on its own isn't enough
  • The three things a factor can be
  • What actually happens when you sign in
  • Authenticator apps, text messages, and security keys
  • Why phishing-resistant is the phrase that matters
  • Rolling it out without a mutiny
  • The mistakes that undo the whole thing
  • Where this leaves you

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM

  • Fix Multi-Tenant SPFx Authentication
  • Managed Identities - Simply Explained
  • More Microsoft Security episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of Microsoft Security: the most-listened episodes
